name: Cafe Bella Express
notes: Photos 1 and 3 are the same printed "Cafe Bella" menu poster (indoor board and window poster); merged, using photo 1 for the fuller Bites & Treats section and photo 3 to fill in the Coffee & Tea/Bowls detail cut off in photo 1.
